subject: Project scaffold & service-account ops for Medicore tenant
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
To: Clara Nguyen <clara@medicore.health>, Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@medicore.health>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Jul 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Project scaffold & service-account ops for Medicore tenant

Hi Clara / Tom —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Attaching a lightweight scaffold (see attachment) to capture the inputs we need to complete org provisioning and seed API access for your team. High level plan below — aim to finish the initial seed by next Wednesday (2028-07-26) unless you prefer an earlier date.

What we plan to deliver in the initial sprint:
- Create two projects: medicore-prod, medicore-staging.
- Seed one service account (redwood-medicore-svc) with scoped API token and minimal roles.
- Provision admin users and invite initial team to Console (RBAC: Admin / Billing / Viewer).
- Provide step-by-step service-account-instructions.pdf and a short rotation policy recommendation.

What we need from you (action items):
1) Confirm list of org admins + primary technical contact (email) — column A in the attached spreadsheet.
2) Confirm whether you want personal API keys for developer QA or only service accounts for automation.
3) Confirm SSO provider and whether you’ll share SAML metadata or want us to create a test group.
4) Any mandatory KMS/HSM requirements (e.g., customer-managed keys) and the KMS provider.

I attached: medicore_scaffold_v1.xlsx — tabbed into Admins / Projects / Keying preferences.

Monica (CS implementation) and Marissa (solutions) are looped in to drive the rollout. Ben will ensure procurement is aware of the timeline and any contract items.

If this looks good I’ll schedule a 30-min technical kickoff for Monday and capture the final scope in CS-4321.

Thanks,

Dylan Brooks
Customer Success | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: medicore_scaffold_v1.xlsx (xlsx, 54KB)]

Hi Dylan —

Thanks for the clear plan and the scaffold — very helpful. Quick answers to your asks below and I attached a CSV export for the admin list.

1) Admins / primary tech contact
- Tom Reyes (Primary Technical Contact) — tom.reyes@medicore.health
- Sara Lopez (Platform Lead) — sara.lopez@medicore.health
- Clara Nguyen (Security) — clara@medicore.health
(see medicore_admins.csv attachment for titles/phone)

2) API keys
We prefer one service account for automation (CI/CD) and personal API keys for developer sandbox only. Please scope the service account keys narrowly.

3) SSO
We use Okta. We can provide SAML metadata — I will ask our IdP team to send metadata by EOD Monday.

4) KMS
We would like to use our KMS (Google Cloud KMS) for secret wrapping. If you support CMK aliasing we’ll provide the key name during the integration.

Procurement note: Paul is cc’d and will review any contract/PO items — he asked about invoicing cadence and an initial 30-day SLA exception; I’ll let him state that formally.

Next steps
- OK to go ahead with the planned projects. Please create medicore-staging and seed the service account with least privilege.
- Schedule the 30-min kickoff on Monday (anytime after 11:00 PT is OK).

Thanks,
Clara
Senior Security Engineer | Medicore Health

Thanks Clara — this is perfect. Quick implementation note and proposed timeline: 

Implementation steps (first delivery, target 2028-07-26):
1) Create projects: medicore-staging (done first) then medicore-prod.
2) Seed service account redwood-medicore-svc in medicore-staging with scoped token and role: API-Caller (minimal token scopes).
3) Invite admins to Console with RBAC roles: Admin (full manage), Billing (invoice visibility), Viewer (read-only).
4) Share service-account-instructions.pdf with command snippets for token exchange, and recommended rotation (proposal: auto-rotate every 90 days; can reduce to 60 if required).
5) If Medicore requests CMK integration, we’ll follow the KMS flow documented in service-account-instructions.pdf — Monica to coordinate with Jonas for HSM/KMS mapping.

Open questions for Clara/Tom: 
- Do you want tokens pushed to your GCP Secret Manager automatically, or prefer we hand off the initial token for you to ingest?
- Any IP allowlist for staging/prod Console access?

I’ll create the Jira ticket CS-4321 and upload the scaffold + instructions. Marissa — can you own the customer call scheduling and capture any procurement asks?

Monica Patel
Customer Implementation Lead | Redwood Inference
[Draft attachment queued: service-account-instructions.pdf (to be shared after project creation)]

Looping in some infra specifics that will impact the seed step.

Jonas notes — technical implementation checklist:
- Please provide GCP project IDs (not just friendly names) for medicore-staging and medicore-prod. We need those to create service account and bind IAM roles.
- For KMS: we support Google Cloud KMS CMK. If Medicore wants key-wrapping, please provide the key resource name (projects/*/locations/*/keyRings/*/cryptoKeys/*).
- Key rotation policy: our default suggestion is 90 days. If compliance wants 30 or 60, we can change; note that auto-rotation to customer KMS will require an initial key import step.
- IP allowlist: confirm any public IP ranges that need Console admin access restricted to Medicore.
- Service account naming: we will create redwood-medicore-svc@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com. Confirm that naming is acceptable.

I will prepare the initial terraform snippet and a short runbook and attach it to CS-4321. Also: if you want keys to be automatically written to your GCP Secret Manager we can include that as an opt-in. If not, we’ll hand the token to your Security contact.

Jonas Weber
Implementation Engineer | Redwood Inference
[Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-4321]
